text:
claire_pm: quick sync — i'm putting together an RFC/PRD for the client SDK surface around retries + streaming (priority for Q2). want to align on scope before i start the PR. high level asks from sales/customers: simple defaults, explicit retry policies, and deterministic streaming reconnect behavior.

sam_devx: SGTM. key tradeoff is API simplicity vs exposing knobs. customers want one-line retry, but infra folks need hooks for hedging/timeout.

rachel_eng: agree. also need clear semantics for partial responses on reconnects — do we re-stream from last token, resume, or return an error? that affects runtime complexity.

leo_platform: from platform side: routing+fallbacks expect idempotent calls. streaming resume would require stable request ids and server-side KV for stream offsets. costs implications for Dedicated. flagging that.

mike_runtime: quick note: runtime already tracks KV cache per-session, but we don't persist per-connection offsets across restarts. implementing resume semantics needs design: checkpointing vs watermark tokens.

anita_cs: customers (finance & infra teams) asked specifically for: 1) clear SLA behavior on retries, 2) opt-in 'exactly-once' semantics for critical requests, 3) migration guide from current simple streaming.

claire_pm: proposed scope (minimal -> stretch):
- minimal: blocking PRD focuses on client-side defaults (exp backoff + jitter), streaming client reconnect = full-failure (client gets error, app retries), docs + examples, perf benchmarks.
- preferred: add a resume token API (server accepts resume_token to continue stream), example server contract, and migration notes.
- stretch: hedged requests, per-token partial-append semantics, tooling for verifying idempotency.

sam_devx: acceptance criteria suggestion for minimal:
- default retry policy implemented in SDKs (python/js/go) + test harness
- streaming client surfaces `on_disconnect` + `reconnect_policy` enum (none, naive-retry)
- docs + one migration example
- perf: <10% median latency overhead vs current baseline

rachel_eng: edge cases to capture in PRD:
- duplicate outputs on retry vs dedupe strategies
- deadline vs per-call timeouts (client vs platform)
- network flaps: rapid connect/disconnect loop protection
- auth token refresh mid-stream

leo_platform: launch criteria from platform POV:
- no regression in routing fallbacks (automated e2e)
- visible metrics for retry counts + streaming resume errors in console
- config knobs per-customer for Dedicated (disable resume, set max retries)

mike_runtime: implementation notes to include in RFC: code sketch for backoff defaults:
```
base = 100ms
max = 10s
multiplier = 2.0
jitter = 0.2
```
plus an opt-in `hedge_threshold_ms` flag. mention telemetry hooks for token-level cost accounting.

anita_cs: risk/rollout plan: 1) alpha with internal teams, 2) opt-in beta for customers in pilot, 3) default enable after 6 weeks and metrics look good. include rollback playbook.

claire_pm: cool. two open decisions I need help deciding before PR:
1) do we implement resume token for preferred scope or keep resume as stretch? pros/cons?
2) do we expose hedging in stable SDK or behind experimental flag?

sam_devx: my take: no resume for minimal — keeps runtime simple and avoids state persistence. include resume in preferred if we can scope server contract small (resume_token opaque blob). hedging behind experimental by default.

rachel_eng: +1. resume increases platform work. but for long-lived streams (minutes) customers will want resume. if we do resume, require a short TTL and clear limit on bytes/tokens.

leo_platform: if we add resume, we need explicit storage/cost estimates in PRD. prefer preferred-scope only.

mike_runtime: agree with experimental hedging. we'll prototype hedging in runtime but gate flag.

anita_cs: i'll compile customer asks and draft a one-pager to attach to PRD. will also coordinate pilot customers.

claire_pm: action items:
- sam_devx: draft SDK API surface sketches (due EOD Fri)
- rachel_eng + mike_runtime: rough server contract and cost notes (Mon)
- leo_platform: config & metric requirements doc (Mon)
- anita_cs: customer one-pager (Thu)
- i'll start PRD skeleton today and aim to open RFC on Wed.

ci-bot: Reminder: create RFC branch from `client-surface/rfc` when ready. :robot_face:

sam_devx: noted. i'll ping with an initial sketch in #design later today.

claire_pm: thanks all — feel free to drop quick points below if I missed anything. :thumbsup:
